Ibrahim Khan: Hey everyone, Ibrahim here — first day on Eng-ML (inference). Laptop arrived but enrollment says 'pending'. Who should I ping for VPN and MDM? Also, any bagel recs near the office? :wave:
mdm-bot: MDM: enrollment pending for ibrahim.k. To complete, run:
```
/usr/local/bin/mdm-enroll --token REDACTED --user ibrahim.k
```
(Automated message — if that fails ping Anita Gomez)
Jess Liu: welcome @Ibrahim Khan! :tada: Anita handles MDM/hardware. For VPN creds I can add you to cloud-jump or Samir can add infra group. If you want ssh access now use:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_ibrahim ubuntu@jump.redwood.net
```
Samir Patel: adding you to infra now. Do you want a quick oncall pairing this week or prefer to shadow for a bit? Also sesame bagels Thursday in the kitchen, plain bagels on Mondays. :bagel:
Anita Gomez: Device updated on our side — remote-wipe disabled, MDM profile pushed. You should see "enrollment complete" in ~5 mins. If not, screenshot the device prefs and DM me the serial. Welcome aboard!
DevX Buddy: Hi Ibrahim — quick checklist: join #devx for a setup walkthrough, book a 30m intro with your buddy, and we'll pair on getting your repo + datasets pulled. Pro tip: bring headphones, and the cafe across 3rd has amazing everything bagels. :coffee:
Ibrahim Khan: Enrollment finished, VPN connected, ssh worked. Thank you all! Bagel plan: everything bagel inbound tomorrow. :grin:
